conference: HPLC Symposium (International Symposium on High Performance Liquid Phase Separations)
abstracts: 657 (HPLC 2025 Bruges: 154 contributed orals OR + 503 posters across 18 topic series; 64 keynotes + 5 plenaries excluded)
spot_checks: Final programme (64 pp) extracted twice: pdftotext -layout and -raw give IDENTICAL per-series counts - OR 154, KN 64, PL 5, and posters 2DLC 20, BIO 37, COL 36, DDD 22, DET 15, ENV 35, FOO 42, IM 9, LAR 14, LCMS 42, MD 47, OMI 21, PHA 56, PRE 13, RTM 18, SAP 35, SFC 17, STP 24 = 503 posters.

Independent artefact, the 529-page Abstract Book (https://hplc2025-bruges.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/250614-HPCL2025-Abstract-Book.pdf), counting 'ID - Title' header lines: OR 153 + 500 posters (union of -layout and -raw) = 653 contributed - within 4 of the programme's 657. Highest assigned numbers sum to OR 158 and ~505 posters, so issued-vs-published is only a handful apart.

Sensitivity: even if the 64 keynote lectures were counted as contributed (at HPLC some keynotes are promoted from submitted abstracts), the total would be 721 - still below 800, so neither reading reaches the ~900 floor or test 1's 800 band.
alt_figures: 653 contributed from the Abstract Book (153 OR + 500 posters), https://hplc2025-bruges.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/250614-HPCL2025-Abstract-Book.pdf
character_evidence: Open call with a poster abstract deadline (1 April 2025) and late-poster submissions; 657 contributed items against 69 plenary/keynote lectures, plus two 'Poster & Exhibition fests'. There is a vendor exhibition and vendor seminars, but those are separate pages and carry no abstract IDs.
method: Rung 3 (count the final programme and the abstract book), ONE search (to find the 2025 site, hplc2025-bruges.org; the guessed hplc2025.org does not resolve). The home page links both PDFs directly. Programme count: pdftotext -layout / -raw, then re.findall(r'\b(OR|KN|PL|2DLC|BIO|COL|DDD|DET|ENV|FOO|IM|LAR|LCMS|MD|OMI|PHA|PRE|RTM|SAP|SFC|STP)-?(\d{2,3})\b') and unique per prefix. Note the trap: poster series prefixes include digits (2DLC-01), so a letters-only regex misses a series. Contributed = OR 154 + all topic-series posters 503 = 657. EXCLUDED: PL01-PL05 plenary and KN keynote lectures (64 in the programme; listed on the site's 'Invited Speakers' page), and all vendor seminars/short courses/tutorials, which have no abstract IDs. Abstract-book cross-check gives 653. Language searched: English (international series; the Belgian edition's site is English). This is the European edition; the series rotates Europe/US/Asia and European editions are the larger ones, so the 2025 figure is not an undercount of the series. Verdict OUT on POSITIVE evidence: 657 counted, below 800 even with keynotes added (721).

conference: ACS Central Regional Meeting (CERM)
abstracts: 626 (2016, includes invited speakers - the series high-water mark I could count; the 2025 edition is far smaller at 82 posters)
spot_checks: Extracted TWICE per the method: pdftotext -layout and pdftotext -raw on the same PDF. Both modes return the identical set of 425 time-stamped oral entries. The -layout run additionally recovers every bare-numbered poster entry, giving a contiguous ID set 1..626 with ZERO gaps - contiguity with no missing integer is what proves the extraction is complete rather than lossy. (-raw drops 22 poster entries, so -layout is the trustworthy pass.)

The 626 is an UPPER bound on contributed work: the numbering includes invited and symposium speakers (e.g. entry 15 'Biomimicry: Sustainable solutions inspired by nature' in the invited Bioinspired Chemistry symposium), and nothing in the PDF tags invited separately. Contributed-only is therefore below 626.

Current-edition cross-check, independently: the 2025 CERM programme (https://cerm.midlandfsm.org/program/thursday and /friday) states 'Thursday Posters 1-41' and 'Friday Posters 1-41' = 82 posters, with only three parallel invited tracks and no contributed oral sessions at all. So the series is not growing toward the floor - it has shrunk by roughly 8x.
alt_figures: 82 posters, 2025 edition (Central Michigan University, 16-17 Oct 2025), counted from the two stated poster ranges on https://cerm.midlandfsm.org/program/thursday and https://cerm.midlandfsm.org/program/friday

394 presentations, 2015 JOINT Great Lakes + Central Regional Meeting (JGLCRM), counted from https://www.centralregionacs.org/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/JGLCRM_2015_Program_with_Cover.pdf - note that figure covers BOTH regions at once
character_evidence: An open call for papers exists every year (abstracts go through the ACS Meeting Abstracts Programming System at maps.acs.org), and the 2016 programme is built from contributed oral sessions plus three poster sessions. The 2025 edition is an outlier: its call was 'abstracts accepted only for posters' with all technical talks by invitation.
method: Rung 3 (count the programme book), ONE search. The search was used only to locate the artefacts, not to read a number off a snippet. Route: the ACS Central Region's own site publishes a Historical Meetings table with a downloadable programme PDF per edition - https://www.centralregionacs.org/historical-meetings/ - which is plain HTML to curl and needs no browser. Counted the most recent full programme book there, 2016 (Northern Kentucky Convention Center): curl the PDF, then pdftotext -layout and pdftotext -raw, then extract presentation numbers with the two patterns the book actually uses - timed orals as /\d{1,2}:\d{2}\s+(\d{1,4})\.\s/ and poster entries as /(?m)^\s*(\d{1,4})\.\s/ - and take the union. Result: IDs 1 through 626, contiguous, no gaps, under -layout; -raw agrees exactly on the 425 timed orals and loses 22 posters, which is the expected lossy-extraction signature. EXCLUDED: nothing could be excluded for invited status because the book does not tag it, so 626 over-counts contributed work and is a ceiling. ALSO COUNTED, current edition: the 2025 CERM programme pages state 'Thursday Posters 1-41' and 'Friday Posters 1-41' = 82 posters, and the C&EN call for papers for that edition said abstracts were accepted for posters only with technical talks by invitation - so 2025 contributed = 82. NOT USABLE: acs.org is behind an Incapsula bot wall (returns an _Incapsula_Resource iframe, not content) and acs.confex.com no longer resolves at all (NXDOMAIN) - ACS moved abstract handling to maps.acs.org, which redirects to ScholarOne Abstracts (acsmaps.abstractcentral.com) and is a login-walled SUBMISSION system with no public programme, so it is not a countable artefact. Language searched: English (ACS is a US body publishing in English only). Verdict OUT rests on POSITIVE evidence at both ends of the series - a counted 626 ceiling in 2016 and a counted 82 in 2025, against a ~900 floor.

conference: ACS Great Lakes Regional Meeting (GLRM)
abstracts: 394 (2015 - and that figure is for the JOINT Great Lakes + Central regional meeting, so GLRM alone is smaller; includes invited speakers)
spot_checks: Extracted TWICE per the method: pdftotext -layout and pdftotext -raw. Both modes return EXACTLY the same numbers - 212 time-stamped oral entries, 184 bare-numbered poster entries, union 394 - and both give a contiguous ID set 1..394 with ZERO gaps. Identical results from two independent extractions is the method's test that a count is real.

The artefact is a JOINT meeting: 'JGLCRM 2015' is the Joint Great Lakes / Central Regional Meeting, confirmed by the Central Region's own Historical Meetings table (https://www.centralregionacs.org/historical-meetings/), which lists joint CERM/GLRM editions in 1978, 1981, 1984 and 2015 and schedules the next joint editions for 2031/2035. So 394 is the ceiling for BOTH regions combined - a standalone GLRM is necessarily below it.

Shape cross-check for the standalone 2025 edition (Appleton, Wisconsin, 4-6 June 2025): C&EN's call for papers describes it as 'more than 20 technical symposia and poster sessions, as well as workshops and an exposition' in a single hotel (Hilton Appleton Paper Valley) - https://cen.acs.org/articles/103/web/2025/01/Call-papers-Great-Lakes-Regional.html . Twenty-odd symposia in a hotel is the same order of magnitude as the 394-presentation joint meeting, not four times it.
character_evidence: An open call for abstracts runs every year through the ACS Meeting Abstracts Programming System (maps.acs.org), with a stated deadline of 3 March for the 2025 edition, and the meeting runs four poster sessions with Peer's Choice Poster Awards.
method: Rung 3 (count the programme book), ONE search - spent only to locate the 2025 edition's own site and confirm the meeting's shape, not to read a number off a snippet. The countable artefact came from a ZERO-search route: the ACS Central Region publishes downloadable programme PDFs per edition at https://www.centralregionacs.org/historical-meetings/ , and the 2015 entry is the JOINT Great Lakes + Central Regional Meeting, i.e. a programme book that contains the whole Great Lakes regional programme. Reproduce: curl the PDF, run pdftotext -layout and pdftotext -raw, then extract presentation numbers with the two patterns the book uses - timed orals /\d{1,2}:\d{2}\s+(\d{1,4})\.\s/ and posters /(?m)^\s*(\d{1,4})\.\s/ - and union them. Both extraction modes give 212 + 184 = 394 contiguous IDs, 1..394, no gaps. EXCLUDED: nothing for invited status, because the book does not tag it - so 394 over-counts contributed work and is a strict ceiling, and a ceiling for two regions at once. WHAT I COULD NOT REACH, and it does not change the verdict: the standalone 2025 GLRM programme is published only inside a conference mobile app ('Mobile app with full program for GLRM 2025 is now live!' behind a QR code) and greatlakesregion-acs.org returns 403 to curl; that is a rung-5/app artefact, but counting it could only produce a number below the 394 joint-meeting ceiling, so the row does not need it. NOT USABLE: acs.org is Incapsula-walled; acs.confex.com is NXDOMAIN (ACS has left Confex); maps.acs.org redirects to ScholarOne Abstracts (acsmaps.abstractcentral.com), a login-walled submission system with no public programme. Language searched: English only, which is correct here - ACS regional meetings are US meetings published in English. Verdict OUT is on POSITIVE evidence: a counted 394 for the two regions combined against a ~900 floor.

conference: World Congress of Chemical Engineering (WCCE)
abstracts: 1,312 (WCCE11 Buenos Aires 2023, incl. its co-located IACCHE / CAIQ / CIBIQ events; 11 plenary + 24 keynote excluded)
spot_checks: The Book of Abstracts is a 1,431-page image PDF (no text layer beyond the front matter), so the table of contents was OCR'd with macOS Vision (VNRecognizeTextRequest, accurate) on PDF pages 1-80 rendered at 150 dpi. Every TOC entry ends in a right-aligned page number; parsing those under their section headers gives Contributed abstracts 1,312, Keynotes 24, Plenary lectures 11 = 1,348 entries, all with UNIQUE page numbers spanning printed pages 2-1357.

Independent physical check: the body runs from PDF page ~75 to 1,431 = 1,357 printed pages, and the book is laid out one abstract per page (rendered samples, e.g. PDF page 700 = printed page 627 'Biodegradation of a starch film in home composting...', a single-page abstract under the WCCE11 banner). 1,357 printed pages against 1,348 TOC entries leaves only 9 pages unaccounted (printed 1, 8, 12, 23, 37 and 284-287 - section dividers or OCR misses), so the contributed count can be at most ~9 higher. Two methods agree to within 0.7%.

Section structure confirmed from the OCR: the TOC repeats 'Plenary lectures / Keynotes / Contributed abstracts' blocks for each topic area and associated event (WCCE11 areas, CIBIQ2023 global symposia GS01-GS11, IACCHE/CAIQ), so the invited split is by the organisers' own labels, not inferred.
character_evidence: Open call (abstract reception opened 5 Sept 2022, deadline 30 Nov 2022; English/Spanish/Portuguese templates), 1,312 contributed abstracts against 35 invited plenaries/keynotes, run 'in 14 rooms in parallel' (Congress Chair's introduction in the book).
method: Rung 3 (count the congress's own book of abstracts), ONE search (to identify the latest edition, WCCE11, Buenos Aires, 4-8 June 2023). wcce11.org no longer responds, so the site was recovered at zero search cost from the Internet Archive: https://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=wcce11.org/wc/template/*&output=json&fl=original,timestamp,mimetype,length&collapse=urlkey lists 'Proceedings-Abstracts_WCCE11.pdf' (431,541,175 bytes, captured 2024-04-22). Downloaded via the raw form https://web.archive.org/web/20240422175525id_/https://www.wcce11.org/wc/template/Proceedings-Abstracts_WCCE11.pdf (ISSN 2953-5565, publisher AAIQ). pdftotext returns only front matter (every abstract page is an image), so: pdftoppm -f 1 -l 80 -r 150 -png; OCR with a 20-line Swift/Vision script; parse lines with x>0.8 matching ^\d{1,4}$ as TOC page numbers and assign each to the most recent section header ('Plenary lectures' / 'Keynotes' / 'Contributed abstracts'). Result 1,312 / 24 / 11. EXCLUDED: 11 plenary lectures and 24 keynotes (invited). INCLUDED, and flagged: the book covers WCCE11 together with the co-located XXX Interamerican Congress (IACCHE), XI Argentinian Congress (CAIQ, papers in Spanish/Portuguese) and II Iberoamerican Congress (CIBIQ2023) - these were one congress in one venue under one registration, so they are counted as one meeting; if the orchestrator wants WCCE-only, the CAIQ/IACCHE Spanish-Portuguese block would need separating. Not separated for posters vs orals (the book does not mark it). Languages: English searched; the site and book are trilingual EN/ES/PT and the book's own section labels were used. Series note: WCCE is quadrennial; the next (WCCE12) was not researched. Counted 1,312 sits in the ~900-1,499 band.

conference: European Symposium on Organic Reactivity (ESOR)
abstracts: 34 contributed talks counted (28 oral communications OC1-OC28 + 6 flash communications FC1-FC6) plus ONE evening poster session whose poster count is not public - so 34 is a floor for contributions; the verdict rests on programme structure, see Method
spot_checks: All four day pages of the final programme were read from the Wayback Machine (the live esor2025.com domain now 301-redirects to an unrelated gambling site): Tuesday https://web.archive.org/web/20250916103040/https://www.esor2025.com/tuesday-9-september/ , Wednesday https://web.archive.org/web/20250916103748/https://www.esor2025.com/wednesday-10-september/ , Thursday https://web.archive.org/web/20250916094723/https://www.esor2025.com/thursday-11-september/ , Friday (source_url). Code counts across the four pages: KL1-KL7, IL1-IL14, OC1-OC28, each contiguous with no gaps; plus 'FC1/6 Flash Communications (3 minutes each)' on Tuesday.

Organiser's own summary agrees exactly: EuChemS event page 'The scientific programme includes 1 Opening, 7 Keynote and 14 Invited lectures and is complemented by 25 Oral communications and Poster sessions' (https://www.euchems.eu/events/20th-european-symposium-on-organic-reactivity-esor2025/) - 7 KL and 14 IL match; the final programme grew to 28 OCs from the 25 announced.

Poster capacity check: across the whole four-day single-track programme there is exactly ONE poster session - Tuesday 9 Sept '18:00 - 20:30 Poster Session' - and a Friday 'Poster Prize Award Ceremony' of 10 minutes. A single 2.5-hour evening poster session at a single-track physical-organic symposium held in one cultural centre (Centro Culturale San Gaetano, Padova) cannot plausibly carry the ~870 posters needed to reach the ~900 floor.
character_evidence: Open call for abstracts (archived /call-for-abstracts/ and /submit-abstract/ pages) feeding 28 oral + 6 flash communications and one poster session, alongside 22 invited keynote/invited lectures and an opening lecture.
method: Rung 3 (count the final programme), ONE search (to locate the edition: XX ESOR, Padova, 9-12 Sept 2025). The conference domain esor2025.com is dead (301 to hongkong-pool.com), so the site was recovered from the Internet Archive at zero search cost: list captures with https://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=esor2025.com*&output=json&fl=original,timestamp,mimetype&collapse=urlkey (returns 171 URLs, including the four day pages, /final-programme/ and /book-of-abstracts/). Fetched the four archived day pages (URLs in spot_checks), stripped tags, and extracted codes with re.findall(r'\b(KL|IL|OC)(\d{1,3})\b') -> KL 7, IL 14, OC 28, all contiguous; plus 'FC1/6' flash communications = 6. Contributed talks = 28 + 6 = 34. EXCLUDED: opening lecture, 7 keynote and 14 invited lectures. NOT COUNTABLE: posters. The Book of Abstracts page (archived https://web.archive.org/web/20250916093539/https://www.esor2025.com/book-of-abstracts/) is a password-protected download ('The password will be sent soon to all registered participants') - not a bot wall and not a rung-5 job, a credential wall. Language searched: English (the site and programme are English; the Italian host society SCI's page http://www.soc.chim.it/en/node/3724 carries no figures). VERDICT BASIS - flagged for the orchestrator: OUT is decided on positive STRUCTURAL evidence, not a full count - a single-track four-day programme with exactly one 2.5-hour poster session and 34 contributed talks. To reach ~900 that one evening session would need ~870 posters, which is not credible for this format. If the orchestrator wants a hard poster number, the only route is the password-protected book of abstracts.

method: Rung 6 (arithmetic off a stated hard capacity), ONE search (used only to locate the 3rd-edition page; the number was read off the loaded page, not a snippet). conference: ICMRBS - International Conference on Magnetic Resonance in Biological Systems
abstracts: 220 posters (plus a small number of contributed orals selected from the same pool)
spot_checks: Poster-board arithmetic re-derived from the four stated ranges on the page: 'Posters 1-41 : room Seehorn' (41) + 'Posters 42-83 : room Schwarzhorn' (42) + 'Posters 84-118 : room Sertig' (35) + 'Posters 119-220 : room Davos' (102) = 220, and the ranges are contiguous with no gap and no overlap, so 220 is the whole poster exhibition, not one hall of several.

Cross-checked against the session structure on the same page: odd-numbered posters present Monday/Thursday and even-numbered Wednesday/Thursday - a two-cohort split of one 220-board series, confirming there is no second, separately numbered poster block.

Checked that contributed orals are drawn from the same submission pool rather than added on top of it: the abstract-submission page states 'If a proposal in the Oral track is not selected for oral presentation, it will default to the Poster with Flash talk track' (https://icmrbs2026.org/abstract-submission/). So total contributed submissions are only modestly above 220 - nowhere near the ~900 floor.
character_evidence: An open call exists ('Authors wishing to present an oral presentation or poster are invited to submit an abstract of a maximum of 2200 characters') alongside a named plenary and invited-speaker line-up - a genuine contributed programme, just a small one.
programme_evidence: Same as character_evidence; submissions run through ConfTool and a poster abstract booklet is published.
method: Rung 6 (poster-board arithmetic off the programme's own stated board ranges), ZERO searches. Route found with no search: the ICMRBS society site (https://www.icmrbs.org/, which redirects to https://icmrbs.ws.gc.cuny.edu/) links the per-edition conference domains icmrbs2024.org / icmrbs2026.org / icmrbs2028.org directly in its page HTML; the 2026 Davos site exposes /poster-exhibition/, /abstract-submission/ and /detailed-program/ as plain HTML to curl with a desktop Chrome user-agent - no JS wall, no bot wall. The poster-exhibition page assigns every poster a board in one of four rooms and prints the ranges verbatim: 'Posters 1-41 : room Seehorn / Posters 42-83 : room Schwarzhorn / Posters 84-118 : room Sertig / Posters 119-220 : room Davos'. Summing the contiguous ranges gives 220 boards. EXCLUDED: the plenary and invited speaker line-ups, which have their own pages ('Plenary Speaker Line-Up', 'Invited Speaker Line-Up') and are not in the poster series. NOT USED: the poster abstract booklet, which the page says 'will be available for download 10 days before the conference' - i.e. it is a future artefact, so the board count is the evidence actually on a page that loaded. The contributed-oral pool is not additive: the abstract-submission page says an unsuccessful oral proposal 'will default to the Poster with Flash talk track', so orals are a subset of the same submissions. Language searched: English (ICMRBS is an international body publishing only in English; the 2026 host is Swiss and the site is English-only). 220 posters against a ~900 floor is POSITIVE evidence of a small meeting, not an absent search.

conference: IUPAC Symposium on Photochemistry (PhotoIUPAC)

Series continuity checked across editions on the same prefix: CONFERENCE 2026 317, CONFERENCE 2025 386, CONFERENCE 2024 409, CONFERENCE 2023 485, and the predecessor NACE series CORROSION 2019 446 / 2018 478 / 2017 486. The series has never been near 900 and is declining.

method: Rung 4 (count the artefact), ZERO searches. AMPP (and its predecessor NACE) deposits every conference paper to Crossref individually under DOI prefix 10.5006, so the whole series is countable from the publisher deposit index with no browser and no paywall - this is the medicine Crossref rung applied to a US engineering society.
